IS 1239 (Part 1).clause_text: The steel shall conform to the following ladle analysis: Carbon max 0.20%, Manganese max 1.30%, Sulfur max 0.045%, Phosphorus max 0.045%.
Tubes shall have a minimum tensile strength of 320 MPa (N/mm²) and minimum elongation of 20% on gauge length 5.65√So.
Each tube shall be tested hydrostatically at the manufacturer's works and shall withstand internal test pressure of 5.0 MPa without leakage or swelling.
IS 1239 (Part 1).key_tolerances: Test pressure 5.0 MPa (50 bar), Hold time >= 5 seconds

IS 1239 (Part 1).clause_text: Tubes specified as galvanized shall be hot-dip galvanized. The minimum total mass of zinc coating on internal and external surfaces combined shall be 360 g/m².
IS 1239 (Part 1).key_tolerances: Zinc coating mass >= 360 g/m², Purity >= 98.5% Zn

IS 1239 (Part 1).clause_text: The thickness of tubes shall not fall below nominal thickness by more than 8% for Medium and Heavy classes, and 10% for Light class.

IS 1786.clause_text: Bars and wires shall be supplied in nominal grades Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600, where 'D' denotes high ductility for earthquake resistance.
For Fe 500D rebar: 0.2% proof stress / yield stress minimum 500.0 N/mm², tensile strength minimum 565.0 N/mm², and TS/YS ratio not less than 1.10.
IS 1786.key_tolerances: Yield stress >= 500 N/mm², TS >= 565 N/mm², TS/YS ratio >= 1.10

IS 1786.clause_text: Fe 500D and Fe 550D grades shall have a minimum total elongation at maximum force (Agt) of 5.0% to ensure energy dissipation in seismic zones.
Test pieces shall withstand bending through 180° around specified mandrel diameter without transverse ruptures or visible surface cracks.

IS 4984.clause_title: Raw Material Grade for Potable Water Supplies
IS 4984.clause_text: Pipes shall be manufactured from natural black polyethylene compound PE 63, PE 80, or PE 100 with finely dispersed carbon black content of 2.5 ± 0.5% by mass.
Pipes shall withstand internal hydrostatic pressure test at 20°C for 100 hours with induced hoop stress of 12.4 MPa, and at 80°C for 165 hours with hoop stress 5.4 MPa without bursting.
The oxidation induction time (thermal stability) of the material when tested at 200°C in oxygen atmosphere shall be not less than 20 minutes.

IS 694.clause_text: Conductors shall be composed of plain annealed high-conductivity electrolytic copper or EC-grade aluminum conforming to IS 8130.
Insulation shall be PVC compound Type A or Type C suitable for working voltage up to and including 1100 V AC (phase-to-phase) or 1500 V DC.
IS 694.key_tolerances: Rated voltage <= 1100 V, Max continuous conductor temp 70°C

IS 694.clause_text: Every meter of core shall withstand online high-voltage spark testing at 3.0 kV AC RMS or 6.0 kV DC without breakdown during extrusion.
IS 694.key_tolerances: Spark test voltage 3.0 kV AC, Zero flashover punctures

IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3).clause_text: Outdoor floodlighting luminaires shall have a minimum ingress protection degree of IP 65 (dust-tight and protected against water jets from any direction).
The luminaire shall function continuously at ambient design temperature up to 50°C without exceeding thermal limits on driver and LED junction.

IS 456.clause_title: Permitted Cement Categories for Structural Concrete
IS 456.clause_text: Concrete shall use 33/43/53 grade OPC conforming to IS 269/8112/12269, or Portland Pozzolana Cement conforming to IS 1489.
Minimum grade of reinforced concrete for structural work shall be M20. For severe marine environmental exposure, minimum grade M30 is mandatory.
IS 456.key_tolerances: Min M20 (mild exposure), Min M30 (severe marine)
